note: Spec 68 §7.5; Spec 69 M-54 dated note 2026-10-07 (operator ruling). An absence ruling makes a target `unregulated` BY ABSENCE for a zone, only when no candidate unit of any layer exists for that target on the lot (and the lot's exception, if any, is captured). The result carries evidence kind `absence`, never a clause, and is flagged for the M-29 expert sample. Each entry is executed against its pinned page by bylaw-s6b-eval.infra.test.ts.
